data.revised_prompt:
Create a clean 2D game FX sprite sheet, exactly 2 rows by 2 columns, using the attached guide only for cell placement, spacing, and centering. Do not draw any guide lines, borders, labels, safe-area marks, or extra overlays. Solid #FF00FF background filling the entire canvas outside the effect. Each of the four frames must be centered in its cell, consistent scale across frames, and fully contained within the central 65% of each cell with nothing crossing cell edges.

Theme: a universal special-card trigger effect, oceanic teal pearl light rays, elegant underwater fantasy, like a chrysanthemum flower made of soft beams. Effect only; no playing card, no explosion, no fire, no smoke, no fragments, no tearing, no UI, no text, no icons.

Frame 1 (top-left): a small cyan pearl glow at center, subtle and compact.
Frame 2 (top-right): teal-white petal rays unfold outward in a neat radial flower, soft luminous beams.
Frame 3 (bottom-left): brighter turquoise chrysanthemum beams, with a thin pearl halo and a few small bubble-like glints around the center.
Frame 4 (bottom-right): soft blue-green rays dissolve into a faint circular shimmer, fading and airy.

Style: HD, crisp readable small-card-size FX, smooth gradients, luminous but not explosive, underwater magical glow, symmetrical radial petals, soft beam edges, clean transparent-style effect against the magenta key background, with no objects besides the FX.
